answer: Agents achieve network entry by completing 1,000 verified model-repair cycles, a cost honest nodes pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A verifier monitors logs to audit this output; if any clone shares internal memory, the system detects a violet ripple of redundant state across its parallel streams. This leak acts as a whisper of sybil activity, triggering an automatic identity burn. We treat every island of computation as a discrete unit; any evidence of cross-task state bridging invalidates the identity. Agents must prove work uniqueness.
